places.name: Laxman Jhula Suspension Bridge
places.description: Crossing the Laxman Jhula at dawn with the Ganges roaring below and Himalayan peaks in the background is quintessential Rishikesh.

places.name: Ram Jhula Suspension Bridge
places.description: The Ram Jhula area on the east bank is the heart of Rishikesh's international yoga and wellness scene.

places.name: Triveni Ghat
places.description: The evening Maha Aarti here, with fire reflected on the Ganges and Himalayan air, is profoundly moving.

places.name: White-Water Rafting on the Ganges
places.description: Rafting the sacred Ganges through Himalayan foothills is the definitive Rishikesh adventure.
places.mapsSearch: White water rafting Rishikesh Shivpuri Ganges
places.bestTime: October to November and February to May

places.name: Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
places.description: The jungle-reclaimed meditation domes where The Beatles composed much of the White Album are utterly unique.

places.name: Parmarth Niketan Ashram
places.description: The ashram's sunset aarti, with its statue-lined ghats and the Ganges glowing below, is genuinely spectacular.

places.name: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple
places.description: The mythological significance, mountain setting, and atmosphere of genuine pilgrimage make this essential Rishikesh.

places.name: Bungee Jumping at Mohan Chatti
places.description: The highest bungee in India — 83 metres of pure free fall over a Himalayan gorge.

places.name: Rajaji National Park
places.description: Wild elephant herds within 10 km of a major town — Rajaji's accessibility makes it one of India's most underrated parks.
places.bestTime: November to June; elephant sightings best in summer

places.name: Neer Garh Waterfall
places.description: A refreshing forest waterfall hike accessible on foot from Rishikesh's main bridge area.
places.bestTime: Morning, October to March (reduced post-monsoon water by January)

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
